name: codex-menagerie-events
description: Publish Codex lifecycle hook events to a Menagerie MQTT broker.

interface.shortDescription: Send Codex lifecycle events and session names to Menagerie.
interface.longDescription: Adds non-blocking command hooks that publish redacted Codex lifecycle events to a remote MQTT broker for desktop gremlins and status dashboards. Includes a skill for setting the current session's friendly display name.
defaultPrompt: Show Codex activity in my desktop gremlin.
Publish this session's status to MQTT.
